segments.text: Narrow country road. Harvest time. Then something huge comes over the hill.
It's a combine harvester. As wide as the whole road. And it's coming straight at you. What do you do?
Most drivers think: squeeze past! There's room on the verge.
There isn't. The reel grabs you. And the combine harvests you. Like wheat.
Out the back pops a hay bale. With wheels. It rolls down the hill, into the barn. Where the cows are already hungry.
Here's how you do it properly.
Pull into the field gate. Stop. And flash your lights once: thank you.
The farmer waves back. And he has an idea.
He harvests you a brand-new road. Straight through the wheat.
You follow him, through a golden corridor. Wheat on the left. Wheat on the right.
At the other end, he gives your car a straw hat. It suits you.
Next exam question: a crane at the building site lifts your car by mistake. Follow, so you don't miss it.
